    int currentSeq = 0;

        } else if (c == '_') {
            if (inParen) {

                }
                currentSeq = 0;
            } else {
                if (currentSeq > 0) {
                    outerMax = std::max(outerMax, currentSeq);
                }
                currentSeq = 0;
            }
        } else {
            currentSeq++;
        }
    }
    
    if (currentSeq > 0) {
        outerMax = std::max(outerMax, currentSeq);
    }
    
    std::cout << outerMax << " " << innerCount << std::endl;
